title: Coarse-graining and quantitative stochastic homogenization of parabolic equations in high contrast
summary: We prove quantitative homogenization results for high contrast parabolic equations with random coefficients depending on both space and time. In particular, we prove that under a sufficient decorrelation assumption the homogenization length scale is bounded by $\exp(C\log^2(1+Λ/λ)) + C\sqrtλ$. The proof is based on a parabolic coarse-graining framework which generalizes the results of Armstrong and Kuusi in the elliptic setting.
